Single_Target.description: Affects exactly one entity within range.

Multi_Target.description: Affects up to N distinct entities in range.

Line.description: All entities on a linear vector from caster.

Cone.description: All entities within a forward arc from caster.

Radius_Self.description: Expands outward from caster to radius.

Radius_Target.description: Expands from a chosen distant coordinate.

Chain.description: Hits initial target, jumps to nearest valid entities.

Wall.description: Creates a linear segment obstacle placed on the grid.
